content.comment_body: Hello, I upgraded an old washing machine with mechanical controls by installing a [product_name] [version_no]. As shown in the photo, I've created several washing cycles. However, whenever I want to change the cycle, I have to load it onto the [product_name] from the PC. I'm wondering if it's possible to save all the washing cycles on an SD card and load them as needed. Thank you.

No, you can only store one program on the SD card, and it must have a specific file name. If you need to select different washing programs, you should implement the selection in an [product_name] diagram.

Hi, while it isn't possible, here are some alternatives: • Use multiple [product_name] devices, each handling a different process, OR • Upgrade to a more capable controller like [version_no] and utilize its recipe management feature, allowing you to select various washing cycles.

You're proposing options that would push any business toward financial trouble... If you're unsure how to design an LSC program for a single [product_name] allowing the selection of various cycles (often referred to as recipes), making suggestions might not be the best approach.
Apologies, [user_name], you truly are the best!
I hope you feel satisfied now after giving the lowest possible rating.

analysis.insight_summary: The original user wanted to store and choose among multiple washing cycles using a single SD card in the [product_name] [version_no], but was told only one program can be saved and loaded from the SD card at a time. Switching cycles requires loading each one from a PC, highlighting a limitation of current device design: it does not support on-device storage or quick switching between several user programs via SD card. Suggestions included more complicated setups or costlier hardware upgrades, sparking some debate about best practices and product limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to easily save and switch between multiple washing cycles stored on an SD card, so they can quickly change programs directly through the [product_name] device.
